violation_type.title: Active Play Safety Requirements for Care in a Public School Facility (26 TAC §744.3101(a)(11))
violation_type.short_title: Active Play Safety Requirements for Care in a Public School Facility
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation does not have a statement in the parent handbook to inform the parents that the outdoor playground area is in a public school facility operated by a local independent school district that may not meet CCR standards.

finding_variants.text: The operation does not have a statement in the parent handbook to inform the parents that the outdoor playground area is in a public school facility operated by a local independent school district that may not meet CCR standards.
Based on the information gathered during the investigation, it was found that caregiver allowed children to remain on equipment they were prohibited from using.
Play equipment is not currently in compliance with minimum standards and licensing, as part of the playscape is boarded up. This does not comply with manufacturers instructions.

The children were allowed to use an equipment that does not meet Licensing standards, the equipment belong to a public school facility and did not have the proper depth of loose field around the swings and other active play areas, as a result a child got injured when fell from a swing.
